description:
Read A2A inbox items, conversation lists, or message history.
Parameters:
- action: inbox, list, conversations, get_conversation, or thread
- conversation_id: conversation UUID for get_conversation/thread
- status_filter: all (default), active, message_request, ignored, or blocked
- unread_only: inbox-only flag, default true
Inbox items include a source field: dm or relay.
name: read_direct_messages
title: Read Direct Messages
